children: Industrial & Commercial Bank of China reported a rise in first-half net profit thanks to gains in net interest income and other sources of income.
The Chinese bank said Friday that net profit rose 2.9% from a year earlier to 169.27 billion yuan, equivalent to $25.18 billion, for the six months ended June 30.
Net interest income--the difference between interest earned on loans and that paid on deposits--rose to 341.24 billion yuan from 313.58 billion yuan in the year-earlier period.
